outgoing.name: British East India Company
outgoing.excerpt: After the decisive Battle of Buxar (1765), Patna fell in the hands of the East India Company and continued as a trading centre.

outgoing.name: Hindi
outgoing.excerpt: Paṭnā pronunciation (Hindi: पटना) is the capital of the Indian state of Bihar, and one of the oldest continuously inhabited places in the world.

outgoing.name: Indian independence movement
outgoing.excerpt: Patna played a major role in the Indian independence struggle.

outgoing.name: Indian Railways
outgoing.excerpt: Patna is connected by Indian Railways to all major cities of India.

outgoing.name: Milk
outgoing.excerpt: Plain boiled milk as well as curd is widely used by all section of the Patnaites.

outgoing.name: Sesame
outgoing.excerpt: Patna has long been a major agricultural centre of trade, its most active exports being grain, sugarcane, sesame, and medium-grained Patna rice.
